architecture.shared_substrate_requirement: both compartments and every intrinsic state advance inside the production spiking bridge; host code may schedule clamps and measure traces but may not substitute for a biological current or state transition

equation_contract.sign_convention: ionic and axial currents are outward-positive; inward Cav2.2 and sodium currents are negative
equation_contract.soma_balance: C_soma * dV_soma/dt = -(I_fast_na + I_kv3 + I_nap + I_nalcn + I_leak_soma + I_hcn + I_axial_soma) + I_syn_soma + I_clamp_soma
equation_contract.dendrite_balance: C_dendrite * dV_dendrite/dt = -(I_cav2_2 + I_sk + I_leak_dendrite + I_axial_dendrite) + I_syn_dendrite + I_clamp_dendrite
equation_contract.gate_dynamics: dx/dt=(x_inf(V)-x)/tau_x(V); each tau_x(V) is an explicit packet function fitted only against its authorized clamp endpoints; no generic HH tau may be inherited silently
equation_contract.fast_na_recovery: availability=w_fast*h_fast+(1-w_fast)*h_slow; w_fast is fixed to the transferred recovery fraction for Stage 1 and h_fast/h_slow retain separate voltage-dependent tau functions constrained by the double-pulse assay

calcium_mass_balance.concentration: Ca_pool=N_pool/volume_pool; both volumes, buffering factors, exchange, and pump constants are explicit unresolved model priors
calcium_mass_balance.sk_dependency: only Ca_local enters s_inf; Ca_bulk has no direct edge to SK

equation_contract.initialization: V_soma and V_dendrite use one explicit packet prior; every voltage gate starts at its own x_inf(V); both calcium pools start at the declared resting concentration; no spike or reset state is injected
fixed_update_order: snapshot both compartment voltages, all gates, and both calcium amounts
compute every gate steady state and tau from the snapshot
compute all ionic and equal-and-opposite axial currents from the snapshot
compute calcium fluxes and both membrane derivatives from the same current snapshot
advance gates by the exponential Rush-Larsen form and advance calcium amounts and voltages by the declared float32 step
derive spike events from continuous soma threshold crossing without resetting either compartment

axial_coupling.density_conversion: divide the same absolute current by each compartment's declared membrane area; never apply one compartment's area to the other
axial_coupling.conservation: equal magnitude and opposite sign before compartment area normalization

calcium_compartments.local: receives proximal-dendritic Cav2.2 influx and is the only calcium state allowed to drive SK
calcium_compartments.bulk: receives declared calcium influx and clearance but cannot directly drive SK
calcium_compartments.geometry_status: shell volume, buffering, clearance, and Cav2.2-SK distance are unresolved model priors

production_bridge_ownership.dispatch: one opt-in SNr structural-successor mask owns both compartments and all listed currents in the production bridge
production_bridge_ownership.double_counting_guard: masked SNr successor cells bypass the generic HH Na, K, and leak update and the retired V14 single-compartment intrinsic packet; no listed current may execute twice
production_bridge_ownership.default_off: when the mask is empty, no successor array is allocated or launched and all existing neuron-family state and output remain byte-identical
production_bridge_ownership.runner_boundary: runners may set preregistered clamps and lesions and read traces; they may not write internal gate, voltage, calcium, axial, or spike state
production_bridge_ownership.kernel_boundary: axial transfer, calcium mass balance, channel gates, currents, voltages, and continuous spike detection all execute in the production NumPy/CuPy substrate

move Cav2.2-SK to soma while preserving total conductance and calcium-volume priors

source_command_protocols.fast_na_activation: hold -100 mV; 20 ms tests from -80 through +30 mV in 5 mV steps; fit normalized conductance using source Erev +50 mV
source_command_protocols.fast_na_steady_state_inactivation: hold -100 mV; 50 ms prepulses from -120 through -20 mV in 10 mV steps; 20 ms test at 0 mV; fit normalized test current
source_command_protocols.fast_na_recovery: hold -90 mV; 50 ms at -120 mV; 300 ms at 0 mV; recover at -120 mV for the filed duration ladder; 20 ms test at 0 mV; fit a biexponential
source_command_protocols.fast_na_deactivation: hold -90 mV; 50 ms at -120 mV; 0.2 ms at 0 mV; 50 ms tests from -100 through -20 mV in 10 mV steps; fit each tail with one exponential
source_command_protocols.kv3_activation: hold -100 mV; 100 ms tests from -80 through +50 mV in 10 mV steps; fit normalized conductance
source_command_protocols.kv3_steady_state_inactivation: hold -90 mV; 10 s prepulses from -110 through 0 mV in 10 mV steps; 100 ms test at +50 mV; fit normalized test current
source_command_protocols.kv3_deactivation: hold -90 mV; 100 ms at +20 mV; step separately to -30, -40, -50, -60, and -70 mV; fit each tail with one exponential

estimators.boltzmann: least-squares Vhalf and positive slope over the complete filed voltage ladder
estimators.rise_decay: linear-interpolated 10-90 or 20-80 crossing duration at the source command voltage
estimators.recovery: least-squares biexponential with both amplitudes nonnegative and summing to one
estimators.deactivation: single-exponential least-squares tail fit beginning after the command transition artifact
